title: New Explorations in Religious Studies; Jesus, Mani and Muhammad- The Dynamics of New Religious Movements
description:
Cross-listed with: HIST289T. Credit only granted for: RELS289M or HIST289T.

Applying historical and sociological approaches to the study of new religious movements, this course examines the founders of long- lasting religions that were part of a dramatic change in the society and religion of the ancient world.
